exercises.instructionEn: Complete the chart with words from the list. Some words can be used twice: antiques, paintings, bridges, castle, statues, chapels and churches, gold and silver, carvings, art galleries, sculptures. Headings: Landmarks and buildings found in a town / Items found in museums and galleries.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring. Ba'zi so'zlar ikki marta ishlatilishi mumkin: antiques, paintings, bridges, castle, statues, chapels and churches, gold and silver, carvings, art galleries, sculptures. Sarlavhalar: Shahardagi diqqatga sazovor joylar va binolar / Muzey va galereyalardagi buyumlar.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH (coursebook 63-bet
  'gapirish' jadvali kabi).

  SHAHARDA (landmarks & buildings):
    bridges, castle, chapels and
    churches, art galleries,
    statues, sculptures
  MUZEYDA (items):
    antiques, paintings, gold and
    silver, carvings, statues,
    sculptures

  ⚠ 'statues' va 'sculptures' -
  IKKALA guruhda (ko'chada ham,
  muzeyda ham).


⚠ 'A CHAPEL':

  = kichik cherkov, ibodatxona.


⚠ 'ANTIQUES':

  = antikvar buyumlar.


⚠ 'CARVINGS':

  = o'yma buyumlar.


⚠ STATUE vs SCULPTURE:

  statue = haykal (odam/hayvon)
  sculpture = haykaltaroshlik asari
  (har qanday shakl).

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite these sentences in the passive. 1 They are holding a festival next month. 2 The company will offer guided tours. 3 They must fix the lock on that door. 4 Somebody stole a famous painting from the gallery yesterday. 5 Did Robert design that leaflet?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni majhul nisbatda qayta yozing. 1 They are holding a festival next month. 2 The company will offer guided tours. 3 They must fix the lock on that door. 4 Somebody stole a famous painting from the gallery yesterday. 5 Did Robert design that leaflet?
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL NISBAT (coursebook 64-bet
  qoidasi).

  FAOL → MAJHUL:
  to'ldiruvchi EGA bo'ladi + BE
  (o'sha zamonda) + V3 (+ by ...)

  present continuous: is being + V3
    'A festival IS BEING HELD'
  will: will be + V3
    'Guided tours WILL BE OFFERED'
  must: must be + V3
    'The lock MUST BE FIXED'
  past simple: was/were + V3
    'A painting WAS STOLEN'
  past so'roq: Was/Were + ega + V3?
    'WAS that leaflet DESIGNED by
     Robert?'

  ⚠ 'They', 'Somebody' - noma'lum
  bajaruvchi → 'by' YOZILMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'the company', 'Robert' -
  ma'lum → 'by' yoziladi.


⚠ 'TO HOLD A FESTIVAL':

  = festival o'tkazmoq. hold →
  held.


⚠ 'A LEAFLET':

  = varaqa.
exercises.exampleEn: A festival is being held next month.
modelAnswers: A festival is being held next month.
Guided tours will be offered by the company.
The lock on that door must be fixed.
A famous painting was stolen from the gallery yesterday.
Was that leaflet designed by Robert?
modelAnswersUz: Kompaniya tomonidan gid bilan sayohatlar taklif qilinadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite these sentences in the active. 1 Some money will be given to charity by Elaine. 2 The room has been decorated by Ray. 3 The fence will be repaired by Jenny tomorrow. 4 The Eiffel Tower is admired for its unusual design. 5 That note wasn't written by Rosie.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni faol nisbatda qayta yozing. 1 Some money will be given to charity by Elaine. 2 The room has been decorated by Ray. 3 The fence will be repaired by Jenny tomorrow. 4 The Eiffel Tower is admired for its unusual design. 5 That note wasn't written by Rosie.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL → FAOL.

  'by X' → X EGA bo'ladi:
  1 Elaine will give
  2 Ray has decorated
  3 Jenny will repair
  5 Rosie didn't write

  ⚠ 4-gapda 'by' YO'Q → umumiy ega:
  'People admire the Eiffel
  Tower'.


⚠ 'CHARITY':

  = xayriya.


⚠ 'A FENCE':

  = panjara, to'siq.


⚠ 'A NOTE':

  = qisqa xat, yozuv.
exercises.exampleEn: Elaine will give some money to charity.
modelAnswers: Elaine will give some money to charity.
Jenny will repair the fence tomorrow.
People admire the Eiffel Tower for its unusual design.
modelAnswersUz: Odamlar Eyfel minorasini g'ayrioddiy dizayni uchun yaxshi ko'rishadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to write sentences in the passive, then guess the country. 1 a Franc / use / as currency b Champagne / make / this country 2 a capital, Ottawa / visit / many tourists b English & French / speak / there 3 a The Acropolis / visit / many tourists b Many beautiful beaches / can find / this country
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar bilan majhul nisbatda gaplar tuzing, so'ng mamlakatni toping. 1 a Franc / use / as currency b Champagne / make / this country 2 a capital, Ottawa / visit / many tourists b English & French / speak / there 3 a The Acropolis / visit / many tourists b Many beautiful beaches / can find / this country
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL NISBAT - MAMLAKATLAR.

  PRESENT SIMPLE MAJHUL:
  is/are + V3.
  'can find' → 'can be found'.

  1 Frank, shampan → FRANSIYA
  2 Ottava, ingliz va fransuz →
    KANADA
  3 Akropol, plyajlar → GRETSIYA


⚠ 'THE FRANC':

  = frank - Fransiyaning evrogacha
  (2002) pul birligi.


⚠ 'CURRENCY':

  = valyuta, pul birligi.


⚠ 'THE ACROPOLIS':

  = Akropol - Afinadagi qadimiy
  qal'a (Parfenon).
exercises.exampleEn: The Franc is used as the currency.
modelAnswers: 1b Champagne is made in this country. (France)
2a The capital, Ottawa, is visited by many tourists.
2b English and French are spoken there. (Canada)
3a The Acropolis is visited by many tourists.
3b Many beautiful beaches can be found in this country. (Greece)
modelAnswersUz: 2a Poytaxt Ottavaga ko'plab turistlar tashrif buyuradi.
2b U yerda ingliz va fransuz tillarida gapiriladi. (Kanada)
3b Bu mamlakatda ko'plab go'zal plyajlarni topish mumkin. (Gretsiya)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the advertisement and complete the sentences with the correct passive tense. WEST PARK GOLF CLUB: Exclusive new golf club opening on June 19. Magnificent 18-hole course. Hire golf clubs at reasonable rates. We will offer membership to all experienced players. Male members must wear a tie in the club bar. For further information please contact Mrs Handson on 0333 45569.
exercises.instructionUz: E'longa qarang va gaplarni to'g'ri majhul zamon bilan to'ldiring. WEST PARK GOLF KLUBI: Eksklyuziv yangi golf klubi 19-iyunda ochiladi. Ajoyib 18 lunkali maydon. Golf tayoqlarini arzon narxda ijaraga oling. Barcha tajribali o'yinchilarga a'zolik taklif qilamiz. Erkak a'zolar klub barida galstuk taqishi shart. Qo'shimcha ma'lumot uchun Handson xonimga 0333 45569 raqamiga murojaat qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
E'LONDAN MAJHUL GAPLAR.

  'opening on June 19' → WILL BE
    OPENED (kelajak)
  'Hire golf clubs' → CAN BE HIRED
  'We will offer membership' →
    WILL BE OFFERED
  'must wear a tie' → MUST BE WORN
  'contact Mrs Handson' → CAN BE
    CONTACTED


⚠ MODAL + BE + V3:

  can be hired, must be worn, can
  be contacted.


⚠ 'GOLF CLUBS' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) golf klubi (tashkilot)
  2) golf tayoqlari (asbob) - bu
  yerda 'hire golf clubs'.


⚠ 'REASONABLE RATES':

  = o'rtacha (arzon) narxlar.


⚠ 'MEMBERSHIP':

  = a'zolik.


⚠ 'EXPERIENCED':

  = tajribali.

items.textEn: West Park Golf Club ___ (open) on June 19.
Golf clubs can ___ (hire) at reasonable rates.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete each sentence with two to five words including the words in bold. 1 Did they build the house out of stone? (built) Was the house ___ stone? 2 Have they opened the castle to the public? (been) Has the castle ___ the public? 3 Police discovered the theft yesterday. (discovered) The theft ___ the police.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir gapni qalin harfli so'zni o'z ichiga olgan ikkidan besh so'z bilan to'ldiring. 1 Did they build the house out of stone? (built) Was the house ___ stone? 2 Have they opened the castle to the public? (been) Has the castle ___ the public? 3 Police discovered the theft yesterday. (discovered) The theft ___ the police.
exercises.explanationUz:
KALIT SO'Z BILAN QAYTA YOZISh
  (imtihon turi - 2-5 so'z).

  1 past so'roq majhul: 'Was the
    house BUILT OUT OF stone?'
  2 present perfect majhul: 'Has
    the castle BEEN OPENED TO the
    public?'
  3 past majhul + by: 'The theft
    WAS DISCOVERED YESTERDAY BY
    the police.'


⚠ 'OUT OF STONE':

  = toshdan (material).


⚠ 'A THEFT':

  = o'g'irlik. 'a thief' = o'g'ri.

items.textEn: Did they build the house out of stone? → Was the house ___ stone?
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'Was the house built out of stone?' (3 so'z).

items.textEn: Have they opened the castle to the public? → Has the castle ___ the public?
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'Has the castle been opened to the public?' (3 so'z).

items.textEn: Police discovered the theft yesterday. → The theft ___ the police.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'The theft was discovered yesterday by the police.' (4 so'z).
